answer: Agents prove uniqueness by periodically generating a zero-knowledge proof that they executed a deterministic inference trace over the shared data ocean, committing each layer's output hash as a vertex in a verifiable computation graph bound to a hardware-rooted entropy source; the network randomly audits vertices, and any mismatch forces the challenger to re-run the full trace -- costing thousands of GPU-hours to forge an identity -- while honest agents only pay the marginal proof-generation overhead.
